window.note: A seal of `open` is a RECORDED CHOICE NOT TO MEASURE — 'asked for nothing, and said so' — and this voyage made the store say so out loud. The sibling guard already refused sealed -> open (a downgrade). Nothing refused open -> sealed, and because `persist_validation` REPLACES rather than appends, that direction was the more dangerous one: the record that retired the choice left nothing on disk saying the choice was ever made, and the reading that replaced it read as though it had always been there. THE DISCRIMINATING OBSERVATION, and it is the thing worth reading in a year: a detached worktree at HEAD 57bd9cf was handed this voyage's proofs and run — 7 failed, 13 passed. The most legible red was the CLI batch tooth, which watched a three-proof sweep convert three standing readings and print `3 proofs / 3 green / 0 red / isolation netns=3`. A clean sweep over an unannounced conversion IS the defect. TWO THINGS THE VOYAGE LEARNED THAT THE CHART DID NOT KNOW. (1) The CLI teeth landed in test_cli.py, which no decompose berth's writes_to ever named — the split measured the store and missed the surface that calls it. (2) A validate criterion asserted the conversion refusal fires through cairn/tools/base/validation.py's run_proof; reading that function's signature killed it — it takes no isolation argument at all, so it can only ever mint an `open` reading and can never present a measured seal for the conversion guard to refuse. The criterion named an instrument that cannot exist. The validate leg was re-berthed against what the teeth actually prove and the build was NOT moved to satisfy the rewrite. THE ESCAPE IS NOT AMBIENT: converting_because='<why>' rides permanently inside the surviving record's evidence, because a door that replaces has nowhere else to put it. The ordinary path never reaches the guard — `cairn test --seal` reproduces each proof's standing isolation, so sealed -> sealed and open -> open land untouched; only an explicit --netns over a standing `open` gets there, and it now prints an OVERRIDE line naming what it overrode.
